setlist.title: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The transition out of China Cat Sunflower is singled out as excellent [10]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): The jam between Truckin' and Stella Blue contains interesting playing and is called a definite highlight [12]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes Of The World is extended, with a freaked-out jam segment following it [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-12-04.sbd.miller.86845.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 128 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1973-12-04.sbd.miller.86839.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 124 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd73-12-04.s1-sbd.miller.30656.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 76 min; rated 3.17/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is good, with Jerry's guitar notably clear [10]
- **gd73-12-04pt.sbd.elliot.11799.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 3 songs; 17 min; rated 2.75/5 by 8 [4]

## Around the show

- Band arrived very late, the second set was cut short, and Bobby told unhappy fans to take it up with the promoter [5]
- Many Frisbees were flying around the arena during the show [5]
- Fans from Penn State were kept outside a long time; the band seemed to fuss over the sound system, starting late and finishing early [7]
- Reviewer's first Dead show: trouble reaching the venue meant a start a couple of hours late, with the Wall of Sound still being assembled [14]
- The band was reportedly due on at 6:00 PM but didn't start until around 11:00 PM [16]
- Cleveland two nights later was a much better show than this one [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-12-04.sbd.miller.86845.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]
- **gd1973-12-04.sbd.miller.86839.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: This soundboard seems to be the same source used for the Winterland 1973 box set [16]
- **gd73-12-04.s1-sbd.miller.30656.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: This circulating source contains only the first set, roughly eleven or twelve songs, so the show is incomplete; Soundboard to master reel to DAT, transferred and edited by Charlie Miller [3][11]
- **gd73-12-04pt.sbd.elliot.11799.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: David Lemiuex reportedly told the reviewer the complete show sits in the vault in excellent quality, though only part circulates [6]
